notes: Web copies are the Blender exports with one change, made on 2026-10-06 with Kari's go-ahead: the scene-level `extras` were removed with pipeline/pack/strip-glb-scene-extras.py. Each export carried there a 58 KB block named `higgsfield` (a Blender add-on's settings: parameter lists at their defaults, prompts empty) with a `scene_builder_id`; no key, token, address or path, and nothing on the site read it. Proven per file: the binary part (all geometry) is byte-identical to the export, and the JSON part is identical apart from that one member; each file is 59,228 bytes smaller. `export_sha256` / `export_bytes` in each entry describe the file as Blender wrote it. The node-level extras (part titles, explode offsets, flow data) are the project's own and were kept. The file names also gained the _d (desktop budget tier) suffix. Manifests: line endings normalised CRLF -> LF, content unchanged. Uncompressed glTF (no Draco/meshopt), 16-bit indices, float attributes.
